scope: Three matched fresh processes per runtime/cell; two operations per lifecycle. No OS page-cache eviction.
Cold source registration/open through fully consumed Q; distinct retained Q2 on same source/engine.
Phase CPU is worker process CPU during the primary clock. Lifecycle CPU includes imports, diagnostics and close; external HTTP server CPU is not separately measured.
RSS is peak process RSS once per lifecycle, not a per-query allocation measurement.
Source counters span through post-query source inspection; HTTP primary counters use the actual primary interval. The outside-primary partition is explicit.
Logical read/raw_prefetch traces can overlap and include cache hits; logical bytes are not network bytes.
Read/decode/normalization/prefetch timers are nested or overlapping; no sum or residual is claimed as independent attribution.
Missing b7 fields remain absent (not measured zeros). Counter aggregates expose n to distinguish unavailable metrics.
Whole-build comparison b7 to d15 includes integrated changes. Zero batch prefetch admissions alone does not isolate or remove whole-build costs.
Source/runtime identities are compared with frozen raw pins, not newly requalified or payload-hashed by this saved-data helper.
